name: Brew Bay
summary: Brew Bay is a sheltered cove on the southeastern coast of the Arathi Highlands. While traditionally home to quiet dwarven farmsteads looking out over the sea, pirates and scoundrels periodically gather along the shore seeking plunder and barrel-aged brew.

sections.title: The Southeastern Coast
sections.body: Tucked away along the eastern waters below the jagged cliffs of the Arathi Highlands, Brew Bay occupies a remote stretch of coastline. In calmer days, modest dwarven holdings made a livelihood off the rugged land and coastal waters. However, its isolation from the main inland conflicts between Stromgarde, the Defilers, and the League of Arathor makes it an enticing staging ground for pirates, cutthroats, and opportunists eager to stash stolen loot and strong drink away from prying eyes.

faq.answer: Brew Bay lies on the southeastern shoreline of the Arathi Highlands, situated along the coastal shelf beneath the highland cliffs.
While rural dwarven settlers have farmed the southeastern coast, the area frequently draws rowdy pirates, brigands, and crews looking to drink brew and divide up coastal plunder.

faq.q: Is Brew Bay involved in the war for Arathi Basin?
aliases: is brew bay in arathi basin
faq.answer: No. The struggle between the League of Arathor and the Forsaken Defilers centers on the inland resources of the Arathi Basin. Brew Bay sits secluded along the outer coast, detached from the primary war effort.

angles.text: Dwarven homesteaders long claimed portions of Arathi's eastern shoreline, finding the cool ocean breezes and stout brewing conditions reminiscent of home.
Remote coves and secluded beaches like Brew Bay are ideal retreats for buccaneers and thieves looking to divide loot away from prying authorities.
